Claude Code Token Management

TokenTrim is a free, local toolkit that helps extend Claude Code usage limits by trimming tool output and optimizing file reading. This results in making Claude Code limits last roughly 4x longer.

What you get

Free version available, Pro lifetime license for $49, Pro monthly subscription for $9

Why tokentrim

TokenTrim is designed for developers and CTOs at 10-200 person US software companies who frequently hit Claude Code limits. By using TokenTrim, users can optimize their Claude Code token usage and reduce costs.

FAQ

Is TokenTrim affiliated with Anthropic? No, TokenTrim is not affiliated with Anthropic.

What are the benefits of using TokenTrim? TokenTrim helps extend Claude Code usage limits, optimizes file reading, and trims tool output.

Next step: Download TokenTrim for free and start optimizing your Claude Code token usage today.
